chunks.heading: Priority rules
chunks.content: Security incidents, payment failures, and data-loss reports must be classified as high priority. The support triage agent drafts a reply but pauses before sending customer-visible messages.

chunks.heading: Human review
chunks.content: Any message that mentions refunds, legal exposure, health claims, or account termination requires a human approval step before release.

chunks.heading: Daily signal collection
chunks.content: The executive brief workflow collects sales pipeline movement, support risk, delivery blockers, hiring changes, and open compliance approvals before 09:00.

chunks.heading: Output format
chunks.content: The final brief should contain a risk summary, three decisions needed today, owner names, and citations back to the supporting documents or trace events.

chunks.heading: Evidence quality
chunks.content: Research outputs must separate direct source facts from model interpretation. Every recommendation should include citations and confidence notes.

chunks.heading: Competitive scan
chunks.content: The research workflow compares positioning, pricing, integration depth, workflow coverage, and deployment constraints across selected competitors.
